tasks.title: Implement Core Configuration System
tasks.description: Create the immutable configuration system with JSON loading and validation
tasks.details: Implement Config.php as the domain controller that loads UDA_CONFIG environment variable, validates JSON format, and creates immutable Snapshot.php objects. Use strict_types and ensure zero overhead when caching is disabled. Implement Validator.php for pure validation logic without side effects. The configuration must support hundreds of connections and be loaded only once.
tasks.testStrategy: Create ConfigIntegrationTest.php with E2E tests covering JSON loading, validation, and immutable snapshot behavior. Test edge cases like invalid JSON, missing env var, and connection validation.

tasks.title: Implement Generic Driver Base Class
tasks.description: Create the master base driver class with core execution functionality
tasks.details: Implement Driver.php as the sole execution domain with GenericDriver.php as the master base class. Implement the core driver interface with methods for connection handling, query execution, and transaction management. Ensure support for all PDO drivers through native extensions. Implement nested transaction support with proper rollback handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Use SpecComplianceTest.php to validate driver creation, connection handling, and transaction behavior. Test with multiple PDO drivers to ensure compatibility.

tasks.title: Implement Driver-Specific Implementations
tasks.description: Create specific driver implementations for supported database types
tasks.details: Implement driver classes for SQLite.php, PostgreSQL.php, SQLServer.php, MariaDB.php, and Dblib.php. Each driver should extend GenericDriver.php and implement database-specific query building and execution logic. Include SqlHelper.php for shared utilities and CacheBridge.php for cache coordination. Ensure proper error handling and connection management for each driver type.
tasks.testStrategy: Create driver-specific tests to validate each implementation handles database-specific features correctly. Test connection creation, query execution, and error handling for each driver.

tasks.title: Implement Query Builders
tasks.description: Create query builder classes for SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and UPSERT operations
tasks.details: Implement AbstractQuery.php as base builder class with shared functionality. Create specific builders: Select.php, Insert.php, Update.php, Delete.php, and Upsert.php. All builders should support named parameters only, enforce identifier quoting, and provide clean separation of concerns. Implement SQL generation with proper escaping and validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Use SpecComplianceTest.php to validate query building behavior, parameter handling, and SQL generation. Test that positional parameters are rejected and named parameters work correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Caching Infrastructure
tasks.description: Create lazy cache system with table-based invalidation
tasks.details: Implement caching with lazy loading (null until cache() called). Create CacheBridge.php for cache coordination and implement cache key generation using UDA|{serializer}|v{version}|{conn}|{tables}|{hash} pattern. Implement table rules, TTL, and stale-on-error fallback policies. Ensure zero performance overhead when disabled.
tasks.testStrategy: Create cache-specific tests to validate lazy loading, key generation, invalidation policies, and performance impact. Test with enabled/disabled cache scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Exception Handling System
tasks.description: Create comprehensive exception hierarchy for configuration, connection, and query errors
tasks.details: Implement exception classes: ConfigException.php, ConnectionException.php, and QueryException.php. Ensure proper inheritance and error codes. All exceptions should be properly typed and include contextual information. Implement proper error propagation and logging mechanisms.
tasks.testStrategy: Test exception handling with various error scenarios including invalid configuration, connection failures, and query errors. Verify proper exception types are thrown and error messages are informative.

tasks.title: Implement Performance Optimizations
tasks.description: Apply all performance optimizations and validate against targets
tasks.details: Implement all performance optimizations including: single execution hot path, no defensive copies, and optimized snapshot reading. Ensure 175% config load gain, 140% toSql build gain, and 450% snapshot read gain. Apply all architectural optimizations from the performance benchmark table.
tasks.testStrategy: Run PerformanceBenchmarkTest.php to validate performance targets. Use profiling tools to measure execution time and memory usage. Validate that all optimizations are correctly applied without breaking functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Security and Compliance Features
tasks.description: Ensure all security requirements and injection prevention measures are implemented
tasks.details: Implement named parameters only enforcement (reject positional ?), identifier quoting enforcement, ORDER BY allowlist, and empty IN → 1=0 handling. Ensure all query builders enforce these security measures. Implement proper escaping and validation throughout the system to prevent injection attacks.
tasks.testStrategy: Create security tests that validate injection prevention measures. Test that positional parameters are rejected, identifiers are quoted, and ORDER BY queries are properly validated. Run comprehensive tests to ensure all security requirements are met.
